fda_source_note: FDA NDA/priority-review cycle verified for chronic hepatitis B with PDUFA 2026-10-26; Breakthrough and Fast Track designations reported. B-Well 1 and B-Well 2 randomized double-blind placebo-controlled Phase 3 trials met the primary endpoint; pooled functional cure 19% (233/1220) vs 0/614, p<0.001 in both trials; 26% vs 0% in lower-HBsAg subgroup. Safety was acceptable but not trivial: pooled on-treatment AEs 89% vs 65% placebo, serious AEs 4% vs 1%, treatment-related serious AEs 2%; discontinuation about 3%. As of 2026-10-06 no earlier U.S. FDA final action was identified. Sources: https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/bepirovirsen-achieves-unprecedented-functional-cure-rates-with-potential-to-redefine-treatment-for-chronic-hepatitis-b/ ; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1131399/000165495426003977/a1144c.htm

Same product was FDA-approved in Sept 2026 for children 4-11 weighing >=27 kg after prior pediatric CRL remediation. Current lower-weight submission is supported by positive pediatric Phase 3 findings plus additional scientific/clinical-pharmacology assessments supporting dosing. Existing approval strengthens safety/clinical context, but lower-weight exposure/dose adequacy remains the key review question and CMC for any new strength is not assumed resolved. fda_source_note: FDA accepted tinlarebant NDA with Priority Review; PDUFA 2027-02-12. Global randomized double-masked placebo-controlled Phase 3 DRAGON (n=104) met primary endpoint with 35.7% reduction in annualized lesion growth vs placebo, p=0.0033; key secondary DAF lesion growth also significant and treatment was well tolerated. DRAGON II is ongoing, so independent replication is not yet complete. Sources: https://investors.belitebio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/belite-bio-announces-us-food-and-drug-administration-acceptance ; https://investors.belitebio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/new-hope-people-living-disease-once-deemed-untreatable-belite
